answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46081 Country: India Title: What to say in standing position after rrku? Question: While performing salah, after getting up from ruku do we need to say 'Sami Allahu Liman Hamidah' and 'Rabbana Lakal Hamd' both as well? Answer ID: 46081 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 985/985/M=1434) In case you are offering salah alone you would read both سمع الله لمن حمده and ربنا لك الحمد at the time of standing from ruku. But if you are offering behind an imam then you should only read ربنا لك الحمد. And if you are leading the salah you would only say سمع الله لمن حمده and as per one saying one should read ربنا لك الحمد also slowly. ويكتفي به الإمام وقالا: يضم التحميد سراً ويكتفي بالتحميد المؤتم ..... ويجمع بينهما لو منفرداً على المعتمد (درمختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
